status: art draft; not connected to gameplay
export: 24x24 native frame export using nearest-neighbor sampling; original generated images preserved

spikeball.directionSpace: screen; choose nearest of eight directions from projected velocity
spikeball.motion: Translate the sprite independently of its four-frame roll loop. Tie playback speed to travel speed; pause when stopped.

spikeWall.motion: Use a fixed facing frame; interpolate position from the start cell to the destination cell. No in-frame translation or rotation is required. Select the lethal face independently for backward/retracting travel.
spikeWall.size: 22-pixel long beam spans a square cell edge, with 1-pixel margin inside the 24x24 frame
spikeWall.anchorDescription: Beam center, shared across all four facings; spikes extend toward the selected direction.

projection: Top-down square-cell placement; artwork viewed from the south at roughly 45 degrees; intentionally mixed perspective
